author: Nelev
body:
Follow-up to #62, which added json-render replies with the card drawn in place of the text.

## What changed

**UI (`medas-ui/components/chat/`)**
- The reply card is now drawn **under** the message text instead of replacing it. The text is always shown.
- `ReplyUI` draws nothing when a spec fails validation, and it owns its own spacing, so a dropped spec leaves no gap.
- It renders the data `catalog.validate` parsed rather than the raw model output, and memoises validation on the spec (the store keeps turns by reference).

**Prompt (`assistant_general_prompt.py`)**
- **Table trigger:** it now depends on what the record search returned, not on what `message` names. Before, the model summarised blood tests in prose ("kidney and liver within normal ranges"), and the old rule "`ui` never says anything `message` does not" then blocked the table.
- **Test reports:** each measured value counts as one item, and a report is tabulated even when every value is normal. The prompt gives example columns: test, result, reference range, flag, with one column per date when comparing.
- **Component table:** it lists every prop and value the TS catalog accepts and marks the required ones. Optional props are left out rather than sent as `null`; I checked that the catalog accepts omitted props.

**API (`utils.py`)**
- `parse_agent_reply` reads `ui` with `.get()`, the same as `severity` and `confidence`. It is one `return` again, and turns with no table store `"ui": null`.

## Probed against the seeded record (gpt-4.1-mini)

| Question | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Blood test results | no table, 3 of 3 | table, 3 of 3 (11–22 rows) |
| Urine test results | no table, 3 of 3 | table, 3 of 6 |
| Medications | table | table |
| Headache, "hi" | no table | no table |

## For reviewers
- Urine comparisons still miss about half the time. A worked two-date example in the prompt would probably fix that, at the cost of more tokens on every call.
- The eval set has not been re-run since #62 moved the agent to gpt-4.1-mini, and this PR changes the prompt again. Re-run it before relying on triage behaviour.
- The component table in the prompt is maintained by hand against the catalog in `reply-ui.tsx`. Both files carry a note saying so.
- `uv run pytest`: 167 passed. `yarn lint`, `format:check`, `tsc --noEmit` and `test`: all pass.
